title: Remote code execution via JNDI lookup in message formatting (synthetic)
text: Apache Log4j2 versions from 2.0.0 and before 2.17.1 allow remote code execution through crafted log messages.

title: OpenSSL X.509 name-constraint buffer over-read (synthetic)
text: OpenSSL Security Advisory [synthetic]. A buffer over-read in X.509 certificate name constraint checking can be triggered by a crafted certificate. OpenSSL versions 3.0.0 through 3.0.7 are affected. Users should upgrade to OpenSSL 3.0.8. OpenSSL 1.1.1 is not affected by this issue.

title: Jinja2 sandbox escape via format_map (synthetic)
text: Pallets Jinja2 sandbox bypass [synthetic]. Jinja2 before 3.1.3 allows a crafted template to escape the sandbox via the format_map filter. The issue is fixed in 3.1.3.

title: nginx HTTP/3 worker memory disclosure (synthetic)
text: nginx versions 1.25.0 up to but not including 1.25.4 with HTTP/3 enabled may disclose worker memory.
